vector_search_builder_workflow.overview: This workflow guides you through setting up and configuring vector databases (Milvus or OpenSearch) for semantic search and RAG applications using local Hugging Face (sentence-transformers) embeddings.
vector_search_builder_workflow.workspace: This workspace already contains working code for this hands-on. Read it before generating new code, and follow it where it differs from the generic examples below. - setup/participant/.env holds the Milvus connection settings the instructor provided (MILVUS_HOST, MILVUS_PORT, MILVUS_USER, MILVUS_PASSWORD), EMBEDDING_MODEL, and COLLECTION_NAME. - setup/participant/common.py: connect_to_milvus() builds a MilvusClient from .env over http:// (the instructor's Milvus does not use TLS), and load_embedding_model() loads the sentence-transformers model named by EMBEDDING_MODEL. - setup/participant/schema.py: the product collection schema and its index (IVF_FLAT, COSINE, nlist 128); the vector dimension comes from the embedding model. - Embeddings are computed locally with model.encode(texts, normalize_embeddings=True). Where the examples below call embeddings.embed_query or embeddings.embed_documents, use that call instead. - To check the API, use FastAPI's TestClient instead of starting app.py; the user starts app.py in their own terminal. - Run the participant scripts with the Python in setup/participant/venv, where requirements.txt is installed.

milvus_configuration.collection_schema:
from pymilvus import DataType, MilvusClient
# Connect to Milvus client = MilvusClient( uri=f"http://{os.getenv('MILVUS_HOST')}:{os.getenv('MILVUS_PORT')}", user=os.getenv("MILVUS_USER"), password=os.getenv("MILVUS_PASSWORD") )
# Define collection schema schema = MilvusClient.create_schema(description="Vector search collection") schema.add_field(field_name="id", datatype=DataType.INT64, is_primary=True, auto_id=True) schema.add_field(field_name="embedding", datatype=DataType.FLOAT_VECTOR, dim=768) schema.add_field(field_name="text", datatype=DataType.VARCHAR, max_length=65535) schema.add_field(field_name="source", datatype=DataType.VARCHAR, max_length=512) schema.add_field(field_name="metadata", datatype=DataType.JSON)
client.create_collection(collection_name="knowledge_base", schema=schema)
# Create HNSW index for optimal performance index_params = MilvusClient.prepare_index_params() index_params.add_index( field_name="embedding", index_type="HNSW", metric_type="COSINE", params={ "M": 16, # Number of connections per layer "efConstruction": 256 # Size of dynamic candidate list } ) client.create_index(collection_name="knowledge_base", index_params=index_params) client.load_collection(collection_name="knowledge_base")

phase.name: ingestion_pipeline
phase.title: Implement Data Ingestion Pipeline

steps.step: Set up document loaders for source formats
Store vectors with metadata in database
Add progress tracking for large datasets

phase.ingestion_example:
from langchain.text_splitter import RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter from langchain.document_loaders import DirectoryLoader import logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO) logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
def ingest_documents(source_path: str, collection_name: str): """Ingest documents into vector database"""
# Load documents logger.info(f"Loading documents from {source_path}") loader = DirectoryLoader(source_path, glob="**/*.txt") documents = loader.load() logger.info(f"Loaded {len(documents)} documents")
# Chunk documents splitter = RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter( chunk_size=400, chunk_overlap=50, separators=["\n\n", "\n", ". ", " ", ""] ) chunks = splitter.split_documents(documents) logger.info(f"Created {len(chunks)} chunks")
# Generate embeddings in batches batch_size = 100 for i in range(0, len(chunks), batch_size): batch = chunks[i:i+batch_size] texts = [chunk.page_content for chunk in batch]
# Generate embeddings vectors = embeddings.embed_documents(texts)
# Prepare data for insertion data = [ { "embedding": vector, "text": chunk.page_content, "source": chunk.metadata.get("source", ""), "metadata": chunk.metadata } for chunk, vector in zip(batch, vectors) ]
# Insert into Milvus client.insert(collection_name=collection_name, data=data) logger.info(f"Inserted batch {i//batch_size + 1}/{(len(chunks)-1)//batch_size + 1}")
# Flush to ensure data is persisted client.flush(collection_name=collection_name) logger.info("Ingestion complete")

phase.milvus_search:
def search_milvus(query: str, top_k: int = 5, filters: dict = None): """Search Milvus vector database"""
# Generate query embedding query_vector = embeddings.embed_query(query)
# Build filter expression filter_expr = None if filters: filter_expr = " AND ".join([ f'{key} == "{value}"' for key, value in filters.items() ])
# Search search_params = { "metric_type": "COSINE", "params": {"ef": 100} # Search quality parameter }
results = client.search( collection_name="knowledge_base", data=[query_vector], anns_field="embedding", search_params=search_params, limit=top_k, filter=filter_expr, output_fields=["text", "source", "metadata"] )
# Format results formatted_results = [] for hits in results: for hit in hits: formatted_results.append({ "text": hit["entity"].get("text"), "source": hit["entity"].get("source"), "metadata": hit["entity"].get("metadata"), "score": hit["distance"] })
return formatted_results

phase.validation_script:
def validate_vector_search_setup(): """Comprehensive validation of vector search setup"""
print("=== Vector Search Setup Validation ===\n")
# 1. Test database connection print("1. Testing database connection...") try: client.load_collection(collection_name="knowledge_base") print("✓ Database connection successful") except Exception as e: print(f"✗ Database connection failed: {e}") return False
# 2. Verify collection schema print("\n2. Verifying collection schema...") collection_info = client.describe_collection(collection_name="knowledge_base") print(f"✓ Collection: {collection_info['collection_name']}") print(f"✓ Fields: {[field['name'] for field in collection_info['fields']]}")
# 3. Test embedding generation print("\n3. Testing embedding generation...") test_text = "This is a test query" test_vector = embeddings.embed_query(test_text) print(f"✓ Generated embedding with {len(test_vector)} dimensions")
# 4. Test search print("\n4. Testing search functionality...") results = search_milvus(test_text, top_k=3) print(f"✓ Search returned {len(results)} results")
# 5. Measure latency print("\n5. Measuring search latency...") import time start = time.time() for _ in range(10): search_milvus(test_text, top_k=5) avg_latency = (time.time() - start) / 10 print(f"✓ Average search latency: {avg_latency*1000:.2f}ms")
print("\n=== Validation Complete ===") return True
